title: Asymptotic Safety
description: Gravity's coupling, followed to ever shorter distances, may settle onto a fixed point instead of blowing up - and then general relativity is a complete quantum theory as it stands.

puzzle.goal: Newton's constant G, probed at momentum k, weakens with a coefficient ω. Write the dimensionless strength g = G k² it runs to.
puzzle.name: Running coupling
puzzle.ask: Find g for G = 1, k = @{k}, w = @{w} (it approaches the fixed point 1/w as k grows).
puzzle.method: Solve the renormalisation-group equation dg/d ln k = 2g − 2ωg² - it flows to g* = 1/ω.
